author: GamingBolt
description:
Control Resonant has quickly become a best-seller for Remedy Entertainment, and it’s a distinction that’s well-deserved. It’s a game that isn’t easy to put down thanks to Dylan bringing some fancy moves to the table, whether against the many enemies in his way or the obstacles the Hiss places around Manhattan to halt his advance.

Manhattan itself is part of the package, and how it all comes together indicates why this title is doing so well. Of course, its success raises questions about the future of Control. Join us as we look into all of that and more in our examination of how Resonant is a game that can have you obsessing over it more easily than you’d like to admit.
title: Control Resonant - Why Is It So HARD To Put Down?

author: GamingBolt
description:
Remember when rumors of the next-generation consoles would fill our hearts with hope and joy, wondering at the many potential new adventures that lay in wait? Raising the graphical bar is nice and all, but there was also that prospect of a clean slate coexisting with massive leaps in our favorite franchises. Maybe some returning IPs, adorning stunning new forms. Fresh stories and gameplay mechanics that simply weren't possible on older hardware.

Suffice it to say that this generation has done an excellent job beating those hopes and dreams out of us, whether it's Xbox's constantly ping-ponging business strategies or PlayStation favoring live-service (and failing miserably at it). But oh well, there's always the next generation, right? Sure, it's probably not justified with how this one barely began, but a big do-over is probably what we need.
title: The PS6 And Next Xbox Could Break Console Pricing In 2028

author: GamingBolt
description:
Despite a delay, our hype for Crimson Desert's first paid expansion, Charting the Unknown, hasn't dulled. Launching October 29th for $25, it sees Kliff and crew venturing beyond Pywel's borders and getting involved in new conflicts. There are new mysteries and threats, but leave it to the development team to introduce several systems that are either brand new or build on what's already available.

Thanks to a new features trailer, we have a better idea of what to expect, and how exactly these influence the Greymanes' lives. Let's take a look at ten new details you need to know about Charting the Unknown, and why it could take a once-in-a-generation experience to an all-new level, starting with...
title: Crimson Desert: Charting The Unknown - 10 BIGGEST Changes You Need To Know
